app.name: ClipperHelper
app.tagline: Turn livestream VODs into campaign-ready vertical clips in minutes.

crash.bannerText: The app closed unexpectedly last time — Copy report

home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Paste a YouTube video link to inspect metadata before selecting clip ranges.
home.componentsMissing: Some required components are not installed yet.
home.recentEmpty: No projects yet. Paste a YouTube link above and click Check link.

components.title: Components Manager
components.subtitle: Download and verify local processing tools (yt-dlp, qjs, FFmpeg, Whisper, and speech models).
components.offlineBody: Could not fetch update manifest (offline or manifest URL unreachable). You can still inspect local components.
components.diskInsufficientBody: Required {required} free space (1.5× component size + 1 GB buffer), available {available}.
components.restartWarning: New data location ({path}) saved to bootstrap.json and applies after restart. Existing data is not migrated automatically.
components.oneDriveWarning: Warning: Folder is inside OneDrive. Cloud sync may lock render files.
components.verifySuccessComponent: {component}: All files passed full SHA-256 and capability verification.
components.retryQuarantineSuccess: {component}: Component version passed verification and is now active.
components.installAllSummary: Done: {installed} component(s) installed, {skipped} already up to date.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics & Report a Problem
diagnostics.subtitle: Redacted locally on this device (no username, email, tokens, or full URLs). Nothing leaves unless you copy or save.
diagnostics.whatDoingPlaceholder: Example: Clicked Install All on Components tab and hit this error…
diagnostics.includeVideoIdLabel: Include video ID (11-character ID only, never URLs or query strings)
diagnostics.previewTitle: Report Preview ({sizeKb} KB / 100 KB clipboard max · ID {reportId})
diagnostics.truncationNotice: Report exceeded ~100 KB clipboard limit; oldest details and log lines were trimmed automatically.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure display language, speech model, and passive encoder defaults without an up-front benchmark.
settings.speechDowngradeBody: small-q5_1 exceeded 1.5× real-time twice in a row. Consider switching to base (never switched automatically).
settings.encoderUntested: Not probed yet — tested automatically on first export (NVENC → QSV → AMF → MF).

E_APP_INIT_FAILED.title: Workspace initialization failed
E_APP_INIT_FAILED.body: Local workspace directory could not be created or accessed. Check write permissions and free disk space.

E_NET_OFFLINE.title: No internet connection
E_NET_OFFLINE.body: The app could not reach the server because your network is offline or unreachable. No local files were changed. Check your connection and click Retry.

E_NET_TIMEOUT.title: Connection timed out
E_NET_TIMEOUT.body: The request or download timed out before completing. The operation stopped safely. Check your connection stability and click Retry.

E_DISK_LOW.title: Low disk space
E_DISK_LOW.body: Free disk space at your data folder is running low. Writing was paused to prevent corrupt files. Free up disk space or choose another data folder in Settings.

E_DISK_FULL.title: Insufficient disk space
E_DISK_FULL.body: There is not enough free disk space to download or write output. No local files were overwritten. Free up space or click Choose another data location.

E_COMPONENT_MISSING.title: Component missing
E_COMPONENT_MISSING.body: A required processing component is missing or damaged (antivirus software often removes or quarantines it). The app paused safely. Open Components and click Repair.

E_MODEL_DOWNLOAD_FAILED.title: Model download failed
E_MODEL_DOWNLOAD_FAILED.body: Failed to download or verify the speech model file. Any existing model remains intact. Click Retry to resume the download.

E_VERIFY_FAILED.title: Component verification rejected
E_VERIFY_FAILED.body: This component version was rejected because it failed integrity, capability, or license checks. Any previous working version remains active and the new files were quarantined. Click Repair to install an official build.

E_MANIFEST_INVALID.title: Manifest verification failed
E_MANIFEST_INVALID.body: The official component list (manifest) failed security signature verification. The app rejected it and kept your existing components. Click Retry or update the app.

E_MANIFEST_STALE.title: Outdated manifest rejected
E_MANIFEST_STALE.body: The server returned a component list older than the last accepted version. The app blocked it to prevent unsafe downgrades. Retry later or report this via Diagnostics.

E_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE.title: Server unavailable
E_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE.body: The component server returned an error response. Your local components were not changed. Please click Retry shortly.
E_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE.not_found: File not found on server. Your local components were not changed. Retry fetching components or report this issue.
E_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE.auth: Access denied by server. Your local components were not changed. Check for app updates or try again later.
E_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE.rate_limited: Server rate limit reached. Your local components were not changed. Wait a few minutes and click Retry.
E_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE.server_error: The update server encountered a temporary error. Your local components were not changed. Please click Retry shortly.

E_ENCODER_UNAVAILABLE.title: Video encoder unavailable
E_ENCODER_UNAVAILABLE.body: All tested encoders (NVENC, QSV, AMF, Media Foundation) failed. Update GPU driver or install Media Feature Pack for Windows N/KN.

E_RENDER_FAILED.title: Render failed
E_RENDER_FAILED.body: FFmpeg encountered an error during rendering.

E_YT_URL_INVALID.title: Invalid YouTube link
E_YT_URL_INVALID.body: Enter a valid single YouTube video link (playlists and channel pages are not supported).
E_YT_URL_INVALID.collection: Playlists, channels, handles, and search links are not supported. Paste a single YouTube video link.
E_YT_URL_INVALID.too_long: Link exceeds the 2048-character limit. Check the pasted URL.
E_YT_URL_INVALID.host: Unsupported domain. Use a valid youtube.com or youtu.be link.

E_YT_UNAVAILABLE.title: YouTube video unavailable
E_YT_UNAVAILABLE.body: This video is not available for download right now.
E_YT_UNAVAILABLE.members_only: This video is members-only content and cannot be downloaded without channel membership.
E_YT_UNAVAILABLE.age_restricted: This video is age-restricted and requires signed-in authentication, which this app does not perform.
E_YT_UNAVAILABLE.region_blocked: This video is unavailable in your network region/country.
E_YT_UNAVAILABLE.private: This video is private or restricted by the uploader.
E_YT_UNAVAILABLE.deleted: This video has been removed or is no longer available on YouTube.
E_YT_UNAVAILABLE.unknown: This video is unavailable or cannot be accessed publicly.

E_YT_LIVE_NOT_ENDED.title: Livestream has not ended
E_YT_LIVE_NOT_ENDED.body: This livestream or premiere has not finished yet. Wait until the VOD finishes processing and retry.
E_YT_LIVE_NOT_ENDED.ongoing_live: This livestream is still ongoing. Wait until the broadcast ends before clipping.
E_YT_LIVE_NOT_ENDED.premiere_not_started: This premiere video has not started or finished yet. Wait until it ends and retry.
E_YT_LIVE_NOT_ENDED.post_live: This livestream just ended and YouTube is still processing the recording. Try again in a few minutes.

E_YT_BOT_CHECK.title: Anti-bot verification detected
E_YT_BOT_CHECK.body: YouTube requested an anti-bot check on this network. Wait a few minutes or switch networks/VPN and retry.

E_YT_RATE_LIMITED.title: YouTube rate limit reached
E_YT_RATE_LIMITED.body: YouTube temporarily rate-limited requests (HTTP 429/403). Wait a few minutes and click Retry.

E_YT_EXTRACT_FAILED.title: Could not extract video info
E_YT_EXTRACT_FAILED.body: Could not extract metadata from this YouTube video. Try again later or open Diagnostics to copy a report.

E_PREVIEW_CONFIG.title: Preview configuration error
E_PREVIEW_CONFIG.body: Preview could not load due to a configuration mismatch. Switching to timecode-only mode.

E_RANGE_INVALID.title: Invalid time range
E_RANGE_INVALID.body: Ensure start time precedes end time, duration is at least 1 second, and end stays within the video duration.

E_RANGE_TOO_LONG.title: Selected clip exceeds limit
E_RANGE_TOO_LONG.body: Selected clip duration exceeds the maximum allowed range.

E_VERIFY_FAILED.title: Media verification failed
E_VERIFY_FAILED.body: The downloaded media file is incomplete, corrupted, or does not match the requested clip duration. Please try downloading again.

E_JOB_BUSY.title: Another job is running
E_JOB_BUSY.body: Only one download/conversion job can run at a time. Wait for it to complete or cancel the active job first.

E_UNKNOWN.title: An error occurred
E_UNKNOWN.body: An unexpected error occurred. Try again or open Diagnostics to copy a report.

warning.custom_ffmpeg: Warning: Custom FFmpeg override is active. SHA-256 integrity checks are bypassed for FFmpeg only.

dataroot.unreachableTitle: Data folder not found — reconnect drive or use default location
dataroot.unreachableBody: The configured data location ({path}) is unreachable. Reconnect the drive and Retry, or switch to the default local location (your existing data is never deleted).

range.title: Select range
range.timecodeOnlyBanner: Pratinjau tidak tersedia untuk video ini
range.timecodeOnlyOwnerHint: The video owner disabled external embedding. You can still set start and end timecodes manually.
range.timecodeOnlyTimeoutHint: Preview bridge did not respond within 6 seconds. Switched to timecode-only mode.
range.adNotice: An ad is playing — range set buttons are temporarily disabled.
range.errInvalidFormat: Invalid timecode. Use HH:MM:SS, MM:SS, or seconds (e.g. 1:02:03, 62:03, 90.5).
range.errStartBeforeEnd: Start time must be earlier than end time.
range.errExceedsDuration: End time cannot exceed video duration ({duration}).
range.errMinDuration: Clip duration must be at least 1 second.
range.errMaxDuration: Maximum clip duration is {maxSeconds} seconds ({maxMinutes} minutes) for beta.
range.rangeMismatchSavedHint: Range changed — updates are saved automatically before downloading.

job.stallWarning: Slow connection / no progress yet — still trying…
job.stallRetryHint: No progress for over 60 seconds. You can retry or cancel.
job.cancelConfirmBody: The download will stop and must restart from the beginning if resumed.
job.interruptedNotice: A previous job was interrupted when the app closed (stage: {stage}). Click Retry to restart.
job.busyMessage: Another job is already running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.
job.proxyGeneratedNote: An H.264/AAC preview proxy was prepared automatically for smooth playback (original source stays intact for export).

homeStatus.deleteDownloadedConfirm: Delete downloaded media and composition files for this project? Project metadata and saved clip range will be kept.
